items.title: Finiteness of the top cohomology modules recognises pseudo-coherence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma turns finiteness conditions on the cohomology of a complex into pseudo-coherence at a degree, and the proof is a 21-line argument reducing the three cases to the third and then splitting the complex by a truncation. It identifies the high truncation with a shift of the top cohomology module, which is pseudo-coherent by the module statement, uses the distinguished triangle of the two truncations together with the cone statement for pseudo-coherence to reduce the question to the low truncation, and finally builds an explicit finite free module mapping onto the degree-m cohomology of that truncation, which is the witness required by the definition. Both reductions and the explicit witness are displayed.
